name: UK IPO trade mark register
description: UK Intellectual Property Office trade mark register: search owners by name or UK postcode, list the UK national marks an owner holds, and read a trade mark's case detail (status, dates, goods and services, owners, representatives, publications) and case history (status, event and goods history).

tools.name: Get trade mark
tools.description: When you have a trade mark number (UK000..., or UK009... for a comparable mark derived from an EU trade mark, domain 23). An unknown number is a not_found failure.

options.name: domain
options.about: Register domain as the site encodes it: 1 national UK mark (default), 23 comparable UK mark derived from an EU trade mark (UK009 numbers), 4 UK mark registered at WIPO, 2 international registration designating the UK.

options.name: number
options.about: Trade mark number (UK00003500001; a bare digit string is zero-padded to the UK000 form; A/B series suffixes are kept) or a pasted case detail URL.

response.about: Read the case detail of one trade mark on the UK register: status, mark text or image, filing, registration and renewal dates, priority claim, goods and services by class, owners (with IPO client id), representatives and publications.

fields.name: dates
fields.about: Every entry of the Dates section with the site's own label.

fields.name: history_url
fields.about: The site's 'View historic details' page; get_trade_mark_history reads it.

fields.name: mark_text
fields.about: First textual representation of the mark; null for purely figurative marks.

fields.name: priority
fields.about: Priority details section; null when the mark claims no priority.

fields.name: registration_date
fields.about: The site's 'Date of entry in register'; null while an application is pending or was refused/withdrawn.

fields.name: renewal_date
fields.about: Next renewal due date; null when the mark is not registered.

fields.name: representations
fields.about: Every slide of the mark carousel: series marks have several.

fields.name: status
fields.about: Register status as printed: Registered, Withdrawn, Refused, Dead, Application published, ...

tools.name: Get trade mark history
tools.description: For assignment, ownership-change and status timelines of a known trade mark number.

options.name: domain
options.about: Register domain as the site encodes it (see get_trade_mark).

options.name: number
options.about: Trade mark number (UK00003000001) or a pasted case detail / history URL.

response.about: Read the historic details of one trade mark: status history, event history (including owner and representative changes) and goods history. Loads the case detail first to establish the site's session, then the history page.

tools.name: List owner marks
tools.description: After search_owners returned a client_id, or from the owner link on a case detail. Follow up with get_trade_mark for the full record.

options.name: client_id
options.about: IPO owner client id from search_owners or a case detail's owner link. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

response.about: List one page (20 marks) of the UK national trade marks held by an IPO owner client id, with number, status, mark type, mark text, filing date, classes and image link.

fields.name: filing_date
fields.about: ISO date parsed from the site's 'File date'.

fields.name: image_url
fields.about: Mark image on www.ipo.gov.uk for figurative marks.

fields.name: mark_type
fields.about: Word, Figurative, ... when the site shows a 'Mark type' row.

fields.name: number
fields.about: Trade mark number, e.g. UK00002195417 or UK0002201095B; input to get_trade_mark.

tools.name: Search owners
tools.description: Start here when you know a company or person name but not a trade mark number. An owner name that matches nothing returns zero owners, not an error.

options.name: name
options.about: Owner name or part of it, as the register spells it (case-insensitive substring match on the site). At least one of name or postcode is required.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based result page; the site serves 20 owners per page.

options.name: postcode
options.about: UK postcode in standard format, e.g. SN16 0RP.

response.about: Search the UK IPO owner index by owner name and/or UK postcode. Returns one page of matching owners (20 per page) with their IPO client id, which list_owner_marks takes. Covers owners of UK national marks only.

fields.name: client_id
fields.about: IPO client id; input to list_owner_marks.

fields.name: marks_url
fields.about: The site's page listing this owner's marks.
